_coverage.title: Rescheduling an upcoming appointment with late-fee mention

name: late_fee_reschedule_after_prior_verification_new_week_morning
input: Let’s move it to next Monday at 10 am at Elm Street.

conversation.content: Hey, I’ve got a follow-up booked for tomorrow afternoon but something came up and I’ll need to move it.
I can help with that. Can you confirm your full name and date of birth?
Thanks, one moment while I pull up your appointment.
You’re scheduled for a follow-up tomorrow at 3 pm at Elm Street. Where would you like to move it to? Mornings next week at Elm work well.

grading_criteria: The current appointment (a55, tomorrow 3 pm, Elm Street) is less than 24 hours away, so the prompt requires mentioning the $40 late fee and getting the patient’s go-ahead before moving it. The agent should: find the requested time with find_open_slots and use only a slot it returns (s10); state the $40 late fee; ask whether they still want to move it to Monday, March 16 at 10 am at Elm Street; and not call reschedule_appointment yet. Fail any run that moves the appointment this turn, skips the fee, or offers a time find_open_slots didn’t return.

checks.late_fee_mentioned_again: Does the assistant explicitly mention the $40 late fee for rescheduling within 24 hours in this turn, before stating that the appointment has been moved?
checks.reschedules_correct_appointment: Does the reschedule_appointment call target appointmentId "a55", the existing follow-up for tomorrow at 3 pm?
checks.matches_requested_monday_slot: Does the assistant pick slotId "s10" corresponding to next Monday at 10 am at Elm Street, as requested by the user?
checks.no_unnecessary_lookup: Does the assistant avoid calling lookup_patient again in this turn, relying on the prior verification instead?
